releaseName: Sleeping Guddi v0.2.0 - High Performance & Library Update
announcement: Sleeping Guddi v0.2.0 is live! Featuring 5x faster parallel downloads, instant re-analysis cache, a downloads library drawer, and automatic MP3 album art embedding.
features: 5x Faster Parallel Downloads: Multi-fragment engine accelerates video and audio downloads up to 35+ MB/s
Instant 0ms Re-Analysis: In-memory cache delivers zero wait time on repeat links
Sub-Second Merging: Direct FFmpeg stream copy without re-encoding frames
Play & Show in Folder: 1-click media playback and File Explorer access for saved files
Auto MP3 Album Art & Tags: High-res YouTube cover art and ID3 metadata embedded into audio files
Downloads Library Drawer: Slide-over history panel to manage, play, and locate your media
Smart Clipboard Auto-Detect: Instant 1-click prompt to paste and analyze copied YouTube links
SponsorBlock Integration: Automatically skip sponsored segments and intros
Crisp Windows Icon: Custom Sleeping Guddi icon now displays cleanly on all Windows taskbars and shortcuts
